title: Redwoods, Iron Horses, and the Pacific
author: Spencer Crump
description: Redwoods, Iron Horses, and the Pacific": The Story of Southern California Edison's Big Creek Project and the San Joaquin & Eastern Railroad is authored by Hank Johnston, a noted authority on railroading, logging, and Sierra-related topics. This 128-page book includes numerous illustrations, maps, equipment rosters, and more to bring to life the story of the railroad that lighted Southern California during its construction in 1912 for Big Creek's hydroelectric project.
